about: An exit that refuses answers its direction and its label with its own words, in quotes or a passage of its place that names the one going, and moves nobody; it is never offered, so `help` lists no way out; once the brambles are cut the exit before it in the chain applies. A direction no exit answers is the world's `no_way`, or the glade's own, which names the direction; other words after `go` are `unknown`.

expect.words: You would need a machete to go further west.
The door is boarded, and you cannot shift the boards.
That is not something you can do here.
You can type: cut brambles, look, examine brambles, inventory, wait, help, take brambles.
You hack the brambles back, and a way opens to the north.
There is nothing special about the glade.
There is no path up out of the glade.
